title: THE FIRST DEMO FIGHT COMES ABOUT 15 TO 20 SECONDS IN
why: His round 2 answer 2.62 b: the first fight comes after about 15 to 20 seconds, a short walk and then the first machines notice you. Measured on 40 demo seeds with a player standing at the start, the first pack came at 22 s and landed 770 to 1060 away, and the median first contact was about 89 s (19 of 40 seeds met nothing in 100 s). The first pack of a demo run now comes after 6 s and lands 480 to 640 away. Every later pack and every career raid is as before.
now: In the demo the first pack of machines now comes in a few seconds and lands close, so the first fight starts about 15 to 20 seconds in.
